name: Clean And Unclean Animals
overview: Scripture distinguishes between clean and unclean animals, prescribing specific instructions for their use, as seen in Genesis 7:2 where Noah is commanded to take seven pairs of clean beasts and two of unclean. The Lord's directives to Moses and Aaron in Leviticus 11 emphasize God's authority in defining these distinctions. The New Testament reveals a deeper spiritual truth, where Jesus clarifies in Mark 7:18 that external things, including food, do not defile a person, and in Acts 10:28, Peter acknowledges that God has shown him not to regard any person or thing as unclean, reflecting a fulfillment and transformation of Old Testament dietary laws.
